G2400.definition_fr:
[Passage conservé en anglais après contrôle automatique :]
ἰδού, 
 [in LXX chiefly for הִנֵּה,] 
 prop. imperat. 2 aor. mid. of ὁράω, used as a demonstrative particle, with frequency much greater in LXX and NT than in cl. (see M, Pr., 11), 
lo, behold, see: Mat.10:16 11:8 13:3, Mrk.3:32, Luk.2:48, 1Co.15:51, Jas.5:9, Ju 14, Rev.1:7, al.; after genitive absol., Mat.1:20 2:1, 13 12:46, al.; καὶ ἰδού, Mat.2:9 (and freq.), Luk.1:20 10:25, Act.12:7, al.; in elliptical sentences, taking the place of copula or predicate (like הִנֵּה in Heb.), Mat.3:17, Luk.5:12 22:31, 47 Act.8:27, 36 al.
 (AS)

G2403.definition_fr:

 (AS)

G2405.definition_fr:
ἱερατεία (WH, -ία), -ας, ἡ

G2409.definition_fr:
ἱερεύς, -έως, ὁ
 (ἱερός ), [en LXX pour כָּהֵן ;] 
un prêtre: ἱ. τ. Διός, Act.14:13; des prêtres juifs, Mat.8:4 12:4-5, Mrk.1:44 2:26, Luk.1:5 5:14, Jhn.1:19,  Heb.8:4, al.; de Christ, Heb.5:6 (LXX) Heb.10:21; des chrétiens, Rev.1:6 5:10 20:6 (Cremer, 293; sur la pl. accusative, ἱερεῖς, voir Thack., Gr., 147 f.; Bl., § 8, 2)

 Jericho: Mat.20:29, Mrk.10:46, Luk.10:30 18:35 19:1, Heb.11:30.†
 (AS)

G2411.definition_fr:
ἱερός, -ά, όν 
 [en LXX: Eze.28:18 (מִקְדָּשׁ); τό ἱ, 1Ch.29:4 (בַּיִת), Eze.45:19 (עֲזָרָה); très fréquemment en I Est.1:1-58 -4 Mac ;] 
  1. En Hom., merveilleux, puissant, divin. 
   2. (aussi dans Hom, et plus tard cl.) consacrée à la divinité, sacré: pl., ἱ. γράμματα, 2Ti.3:15. 
   3. Comme subst., 
   (a) (ainsi dans Hom.), τὰ ἱ., sacrifices, rites sacrés, choses sacrées: 1Co.9:13; 
  b) plus tard, τὸ ἱ., un lieu consacré ou sacré, un temple: τ. Ἀρτέμιδος, Act.19:27; du temple de Jérusalem, c'est-à-dire de l'ensemble des locaux ou d'une partie de ceux-ci (différents de ὁ ναός, qui voient, le Sanctuaire proprement dit: 1Co.9:13, et souvent dans Gosp. et esp. en Ac, Mat.12:6, Mrk.13:3, Act.4:1, al. (sur l'utilisation ἱ. dans Imperial Iuser., voir Deiss., LAE, 380 f.) 
 (AS)

 (ἱερός, πρέπει) [en LXX: 4Ma.9:25 4Mac 11:20 * ;] 
 adapté à un caractère sacré, révérend (RV, reverent): Tit.2:3 (cf. Tr., Syn., § xcii).†
 (AS)

 [en LXX: Sir.50:27 (28) 2Ma.4:22 2Mac 4:39 (V* -μήτης) 2 mai 18:5* ;] 
un habitant de Jérusalem: Mrk.1:5, Jhn.7:25.†
 (AS)

 (ἱερόσυλος, qui voient), [en LXX: 2Ma.9:2 * ;] 
pour voler un temple (sacrilège, R, mg): Rom.2:22.†

braquer des temples: Act.19:37.†
 (AS)

ἱερουργέω, -ῶ
 (ἱερουργός, un prêtre sacrifiant) [en LXX: 4Ma.7:3 R (de -γία, 4Mac 3:30 א R)* ;] 
d'accomplir des rites sacrés; avec l'accusatif, de servir dans le service sacerdotal (ministre en sacrifice, R, mg.), τὸ εὐαγγέλιον, Rom.15:16.†

G2425.definition_fr:
[Passage conservé en anglais après contrôle automatique :]
ἱκανός, -ή, -όν
 (ἵκω, ἱκάνω, to reach, attain), [in LXX for דַּי, etc. ;] 
__1. of persons, suffcient, competent, fit: with inf., Mat.3:11, Mrk.1:7, Luk.3:16, 1Co.15:9, 2Co.3:6, 2Ti.2:2; before πρός, 2Co.2:16; before ἵνα, Mat.8:8, Luk.7:6. 
 __2. Of things, in number, quantity or size, sufficient, enough, much, many: absol., ἱκανοί, Luk.7:11 (WH, R, omit) Luk.8:32, Act.12:12 14:21 19:19, 1Co.11:30; ὄχλος ἱ., Mrk.10:46, Luk.7:12, Act.11:24, 26 19:26; κλαυθμός, Act.20:37; ἀργύρια, Mat.28:12; λαμπάδες, Act.20:8; λόγοι, Luk.23:9; φῶς, Act.22:6; ἱ, ἐστιν (cf. לָכֶם רַב, LXX ἱκανούσθω, Deu.3:26), Luk.22:38; τὸ ἱ. ποιεῖν (Lat. satisfacere; cf. Jer.48:30), Mrk.15:15; τὸ ἱ. λαμβάνειν (Lat. satis accipere; see M, Pro.20:1-30 f.), Act.17:9; of time, ἡμέραι ἱ., Act.9:23, 43 18:18 27:7; ἱ. χρόνος, Luk.8:27, Act.8:11 14:3 27:9; pl., Luk.20:9; ἐκ χρόνων ἱ., Luk.23:8; ἀπὸ ἱ. ἐτῶν, Rom.15:23 (WH); ἐφ ̓ ἱκανόν (cf. 2Ma.8:25), Act.20:11.†
 (AS)

G2427.definition_fr:
ἱκανόω, -ῶ
 (ἱκανός ), [en LXX, principalement pour רַב ;] 
pour rendre suffisant, rendre apte: avec dupl. accusative, 2Co.3:6; avec accusation de personne(s) avant εἰς, Col.1:12.†
 (AS)

G2428.definition_fr:
ἱκετήριος, -α, -ον
 (ἱκέτης, un survivant), [en LXX: Job.40:22, 2Ma.9:18 * ;] 
d'une personne en état d'ivresse; comme subst., ἡ ἱ. (Sc. ῥάβδος), 
   1. en cl., une branche d'olive, portée par un suspenseur. 
   2. À la fin de Gk. = ἱκεσία, supplication: pl., δεήσεις κ. ἱ., Heb.5:7 
 SYN.: voir: δέησις  (AS)

G2433.definition_fr:
ἱλάσκομαι
 (ἵλαος = ἵλεως) [en LXX (cf. Westc., Epp. Jo., 85 f.) pour סָלַח, 4Ki.5:18 24:4, Psa.25:11, La 3:42, Da TH Dan.9:19; כָּפַר - Non, non. Psa.65:3 78:38 79:9; נָחַם - Oui, oui. Exo.32:14, Est.4:17 * ;] 
  1. en cl., avec l'accusatif de personne(s), pour concilier, apaiser, propitier (= ἐξιλάσκομαι, Gen.32:20, Pro.16:14, Mal.1:9, al.). 
   2. Dans LXX (Thackeray, Gr., 270, 1.), Inscr. (Deiss., BS, 224 f.) et NT, d'être propice, miséricordieux (avec dative de chose(s), Psa.79:9, al.): avec datif de personne (4Ki.5:18), Luk.18:13. 
   3. Comme dans Philo (= ἐξιλάσκ-, en LXX: Eze.43:22, al.), pour expier, faire propitiation pour: τ. ἁμαρτίας, Heb.2:17 (Cremer, 301 ss, 735).†
 (AS)

G2434.definition_fr:
ἱλασμός, -οῦ
 (ἱλάσκομαι ), [en LXX: Lev.25:9, Num.5:8 (כִּפֻּר), Psa.130:4, Da TH Dan.9:9 (סְלִיחָה), Amo.8:14 (אַשְׁמָה), Eze.44:27 (חַטָּאָה), 1Ch.28:20, Sir.18:20 A, 2Ma.3:33 * ;] 
  1. un apaisant (Plut.). 
   2. un moyen d'apaisement, de propitiation (Philo; Nu, Ez, ll.with): 1Jn.2:2 Jn 4:10. 
   3. Dans LXX également pardon (Ps, Da TH, ll.with).†
 (AS)

G2435.definition_fr:
ἱλαστήριος, -α, -ον

 (AS)

G2436.definition_fr:

G2468.definition_fr:
[Passage conservé en anglais après contrôle automatique :]
εἰμί, 
 with various uses and significations, like the English verb to be. 
__I. As substantive verb. 
__1. Of persons and things, to be, exist: Act.17:28, Jhn.1:1, 8:58, 17:5, al; ὁ ὢν καὶ ὁ ἦν (for past ptcp.), Rev.1:4, 8, 4:8, 11:17, 16:5 (see Swete, Ap., 5; M, Pr., 228); τὰ (μὴ) ὄντα, Rom.4:17, 1Co.1:28. 
 __2. Of times, events, etc., to be, happen, take place: Mat.24:3, Mrk.14:2, 15:42, Luk.21:23, Jhn.4:6, 23, 5:10, al. 
 __3. to be present, be in a place, have come: Mat.2:13, 15, Mrk.1:45, 5:21, 15:40, Luk.1:80, 5:29, Jhn.7:30, al.; before εἰς, Mrk.2:1; before  ἐκ, (ἐξ), Mat.1:20, 21:25, Mrk.11:30, Jhn.3:31, al. 
 __4. Impers.,  ἔστι, ἦν, etc.; 
__(a) there is (Fr. il y a), was, etc.: Mat.16:28, Luk.16:19, Jhn.3:1, 5:2, Rom.3:10, al.; with dative (of the possessor; Bl., §37, 3), Mat.16:22, Luk.1:7, Jhn.18.10, Rom.9:2, al.;  ἔστιν ὅς, ὅστις (chiefly in pl), Mat.16:28, 19:2, Mrk.9:1, al.; 
 __(b) with inf., = ἔξεστιν (which see), it is possible: Heb.9:5, 1Co.11:20, RV (but see ICC, in l.).
     __II. As copula uniting subject and predicate. 
__1. Expressing simply identity or equivalence: Mat.5:13, 14:15, Luk.1:18, 19, Jhn.1:1, 4:19, Rev.3:9, al. mult.
 __2. Explicative, as in parable, figure, type, etc.: Mat.13:19, 1Co.9:2, 10:4, 11:25, Gal.4:24, Rev.17:15, al.; ταῦτ᾽ ἔστιν, Mat.27:46, Mrk.7:2, Rom.7:18 al.; ὅ ἐστιν, Mrk.3:17, Col.1:24, Heb.7:2, al.; akin to this is the sacramental usage: Mat.26:26-28, Mrk.14:22, 24, Luk.22:19, 1Co.11:24 (see ICC on Mk, I Co, ll. with; DB, iii, 148 f.). 
 __3. C. genitive: qual., etc., Mrk.5:42, Luk.3:23, 1Co.14:33, Heb.12:11, al.; part., 1Ti.1:20, 2Ti.1:15; poss., Mat.5:3, 10, Mrk.12:7, Luk.4:7; of service or partisanship, Rom.8:9, 1Co.1:12, 2Co.10:7, 2Ti.2:19. 
 __4. C. dative (BL, §37, 3): Act.1:8, 9:15, Rom.4:12, 1Co.1:18, 2:14, Rev.21:7, al. 
 __5. C. ptcp., as a periphrasis for the simple verb (Bl., §62, 1, 2; M, Pr., 225 ff.); 
__(a) with ptcp. pf. (cl.): Mat.10:30, Luk.9:32, Jhn.3:24, Act.21:35, 1Co.15:19, al; 
 __(b) with ptcp. pr. (esp. in impf., as in Heb. and Aram.; Dalman, Words, 35 f.), Mat.7:29, Mrk.1:22, Luk.4:31, 14:1, Act.1:10, al. mult., id. for imper. (M, Pr., 180f., 182f.), with ellipsis of εἰμί, Rom.12:9, 10, Heb.13:5, al.;
 __(with) with ptcp. aor. (cl), Luk.23:9.
 __6. Seq. εἰς (cf. Heb. הָיָה לְ), a vernac. usage (M, Pr., 71): Mat.19:5, Mrk.10:8, Heb.8:10, al. 
 __7. C. adv.: Mat.19:20, Mrk.4:26, Luk.18:11, al. 
 __8. Ellipses; 
__(a) of the copula (Bl., §30, 3): Mat.8:29, 24:32, Jhn.21:22, 23, Heb.6:4, al.;
 __(b) of the predicate: ἐγώ εἰμί, Mat.14:27, Mrk.6:50, al.; absol. (cf. Deu.32:39; אֲנִי הוּא), Mrk.13:6, Jhn.4:26, al. (cf. ἄπ-, ἔν-, πάρ-, συμ-πάρ-, σύν-ειμι).
 (AS)
